finding: Credit line stress persists as bank loan and trade credit conditions ease
bullets: The Slovak credit line gap widened to +15.3pp (n=270) from +14.8pp in the previous wave, driven by need rising to a net +15.2pp, leaving Slovak firms 1.3pp more stressed than the euro area.
The Slovak bank loan gap improved to -6.0pp (n=214) from -4.0pp, as availability rose to a net +5.6pp from +1.4pp — placing Slovak firms 8.8pp less stressed than the euro area's +2.8pp.
The Slovak trade credit gap swung to -1.7pp (n=180) from +6.3pp, as need fell to a net -3.4pp from +7.1pp, leaving Slovak firms 12.7pp less stressed than the euro area.
chart_subtitle: Slovak credit line gap at +15.3pp, exceeding euro area.
